evidenceContract.userBehavior: Send an ordinary greeting while the Draft carries the configured default image-generation purpose.

observables.description: Effective chat model, terminal state, runtime diagnostics, final answer, and absence of a GenerateImage Tool call.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The ordinary message completes through agent.main and does not invoke GenerateImage merely because image.generate is configured.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: A media credential preflight failure, image provider invocation, GenerateImage Tool call, model fallback, runtime error, or missing terminal answer fails visibly.

steps.prompt: Hello. Reply with the exact text ORDINARY_CHAT_OK. Do not generate or edit media.
